claim: The demo loads sample data, can be reset, and never changes real records.
sandbox: Create a real record, enter /demo, reset it, then return to the unchanged real notebook.

claim: A complete practice stays on this product origin.
sandbox: Complete the demo retry and record every browser request.

claim: You can practice without an account.
sandbox: Open /demo and complete a retry without an identity or sign-in step.

claim: Practice makes no third-party tracking request.
sandbox: Capture requests through a demo retry and assert every one is same-origin.

claim: Practice records are stored in browser storage.
sandbox: Add a demo concept, reload /demo, and observe the saved concept.

claim: Each practice asks what it is, why it works, and where it fails or trades off.
where: How it works, practice form, README
sandbox: Open the sample practice and observe all three labelled prompts.

claim: The optional timer runs for 90 seconds.
sandbox: Run the sample timer with a browser clock advanced exactly 90 seconds.

claim: You decide whether a retry feels clearer; the app does not issue a correctness grade.
where: What this tool does not do, retry reflection, Terms
sandbox: Complete the sample retry and observe the two learner-led reflection choices.

claim: Audio stays in IndexedDB and is excluded from text exports.
sandbox: Store an audio-bearing demo attempt in IndexedDB and inspect the JSON download.

claim: You can export practice records as JSON.
sandbox: Download the populated demo backup and parse its concepts and omissions.

claim: You can export practice records as CSV.
sandbox: Download the populated demo CSV and verify its header and every exported row.

claim: You can restore a valid JSON backup.
sandbox: Import a valid fixture into /demo and observe that it replaces the sample.

claim: You can delete all local practice data.
sandbox: Confirm Delete all data in /demo and observe empty records and retry states.

claim: An unfinished written explanation survives a refresh.
sandbox: Write in the sample form, reload its direct route, and verify the field value.

claim: The demo works offline after its first visit.
sandbox: Use a fresh browser context, install the worker from /demo, switch offline, and reload.

claim: The app shell is cached after the first visit.
sandbox: After worker control, inspect the browser Cache API for the cached shell.

claim: Only pieces you mark missing are scheduled for retry.
where: How it works, retry section, README
sandbox: Complete a demo explanation with no entered omission and verify it gets no retry.

claim: A retry asks for the one marked piece, not the whole topic.
where: How it works, retry screen, README
sandbox: Open the seeded retry and verify its prompt names only the marked omission.

claim: You can complete the sample without payment.
sandbox: Complete the sample retry and assert no payment, upgrade, or subscription step appears.

claim: When a newer app version is waiting, you can apply it from the app.
sandbox: Serve a changed worker, observe the update action, apply it, and verify activation.
